name: Ofek Vayner
biography: Ofek Vayner is an M.Sc student at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev and a security researcher at BGU's Cyber Security Research Center. He holds a B.Sc. degree from the Department of Electrical Engineering at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev. His Primary research interests are side-channel attacks and cryptanalysis.
